name: cloud-billing-exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for Azure/GCP/Hetzner cloud spend. Polls each provider's billing API and exposes current cost by service/project/currency in Prometheus text format. Config is a JSON file (see config.example.json in the repo) plus per-provider credential files, all read-only bind mounts - never baked into the image.

paths.name: config
paths.description: Read-only bind mount holding config.json (see config.example.json in the repo) and any provider credential files it references.

variables.name: CONFIG_PATH
variables.description: Path to config.json inside the container.
